group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the group-suffixed links/segment alignment and snoc helper family once. entail_wit_1 opens the DLL and instantiates done=nil. entail_wit_2_1 unfolds the remaining segment, extends the prefix, derives the no-wrap bound from store_align4_n_valid, rewrites unsigned_last_nbits, and instantiates the updated invariant. entail_wit_2_2 handles the first node by one unfold and constant arithmetic. return_wit_1 uses the same snoc/distinct helpers to close the nonempty processed prefix; return_wit_2 reduces the empty case and closes the sentinel DLL. The derived nil contract chooses nodes=nil and retval=0 under wand adjunction.
expected_helpers: five group-id-suffixed proved declarations if not kept as theorem-local assertions
